name: Buff: Force
effect: Add $lowDamage to the target's first Strike each turn if it hits.

name: Buff: Guard
effect: The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to $moderateDamage.

name: Buff: Motion
effect: The target gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds.

name: Repelling Strike
effect: Your ranged Strikes deal nonlethal damage. A creature hit by one attempts the saving throw; failure pushes it 10 feet, and critical failure pushes it 20 feet.

name: Escalating Strike
effect: Make a melee Strike. If you hit the target with Escalating Strike during the previous round, it deals $extremeDamage instead of the listed damage.

name: Hazardous Scatter
effect: The area becomes difficult, hazardous terrain. A creature moving on the ground takes $terribleDamage for each square of the area it enters.

name: Walking Hazard
duration: Until the end of your third turn.
area: 45-foot line originating from you in one direction [special]
effect: Release a walking hazard. It moves 15 feet along the line immediately and again at the start of each of your next two turns. A creature takes the listed damage, subject to the saving throw, when the hazard moves adjacent to it or it moves adjacent to the hazard. A creature can take this damage only once per round.

name: Elemental Upheaval
effect: Creatures in the area take $lowDamage, subject to the saving throw. The ground becomes difficult, hazardous terrain; a creature moving through it takes $terribleDamage for each square it enters. You are immune to this ability's effects.

name: Instant Trap
effect: Build a trap on a surface in the target square. The next creature to move adjacent to it takes the listed damage, subject to the saving throw, and, on a failed save, a –5-foot penalty to its Speed. The trap is destroyed when triggered. Use the attached trap stat block for its statistics.

name: Prepared Trap
target: One object that can be opened.
area: 10-foot burst centered on the object when opened
effect: Before combat, place a prepared trap on an object that can be opened. A Perception check reveals the trap; two successful Thievery checks disable it. Opening the object without disabling the trap deals the listed damage to creatures in the area, subject to the saving throw. Use the attached trap stat block for its statistics.

name: Mine
effect: Place a mine in the target square. It triggers when a creature enters the square, dealing the listed damage, subject to the saving throw. Use the attached trap stat block for its statistics.

name: Thrown Burst
effect: Lob an attack into the area; you don't need line of sight to the area. Creatures in it take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Final Burst
trigger: You are reduced to 0 Hit Points.
effect: Creatures in the area take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Aim and Fire Artillery
effect:
Select a grid intersection within range and mark it for an artillery attack; line of sight is not required. The targeted area is visibly indicated, and all combatants know which area will be affected.

**Delayed Impact:** At the start of your next turn (or when that turn would have started if you are incapacitated or destroyed), the attack resolves at the designated location. Creatures in the area take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

**Committed Attack:** Once the area is designated, the attack cannot be redirected or canceled, even if you move, become incapacitated, or are destroyed.

**Artillery Disruption:** You cannot use Aim and Fire Artillery if you have been critically hit by a Strike since the end of your previous turn. This does not affect attacks already designated.

name: Pariah Aura
effect: Any creature other than you that starts its turn in the aura becomes a Lifelink recipient, with you as its donor. Each new link increases your stunned value by 1.

name: Lifelink
effect:
You act as the donor for one or more recipients. You can have multiple recipients, but each recipient can have only one donor.
- Damage: Whenever a recipient would take damage, half that damage is transferred to you instead. Transferred damage cannot be transferred again.
- Healing: Whenever you would regain HP, divide that healing equally among you and all your recipients. Excess healing is lost.
- Range: The link ends immediately when a recipient moves more than 60 feet from you.
Round fractions down, assigning any remainder to you.

name: In the Crosshairs
effect:
Designate one creature as your Crosshairs target. The target can attempt the saving throw whenever it uses Take Cover, removing the condition on a success.

You can have only one Crosshairs target at a time. Designating a new target removes the condition from the previous target.

name: Sniper Strike
requirements: The target is affected by In the Crosshairs; your weapon is loaded; Reload 1.
effect: Make a ranged Strike using the listed statistics. On a hit, deal additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage.

name: Blood Curse
effect:
The target attempts the saving throw, taking the listed persistent damage with the following effects:
- Critical Success: No effect.
- Success: Half damage.
- Failure: Full damage.
- Critical Failure: Double damage.

name: Berserker
effect:
You have the Barbarian's Rage ability. You begin combat without Rage active and use Rage on your first turn.

On subsequent turns, you must use Mindless Rush and Battle-Mad Swing once each, in either order, whenever able. Your remaining actions are unrestricted.

name: Battle-Mad Swing
frequency: Once per turn, required every turn
effect:
Randomly select an adjacent creature, ally or enemy, and make a melee Strike against it. If no creatures are adjacent, swing at empty air.

This Strike neither takes nor increases your multiple attack penalty.

name: Mindless Rush
frequency: Once per turn, required every turn
effect: Stride up to $speed toward the nearest enemy to which you are not already adjacent, taking the shortest available route. If no such enemy exists, do not move.

name: Moving Target Shot
trigger: A creature within $rangedRange begins an action with the move trait.
requirements: You can make a ranged Strike against the triggering creature.
effect: Make a ranged Strike against the creature before it moves. On a critical hit, the triggering move action is disrupted.

name: Downed Prey
effect: Your melee Strikes against prone creatures deal additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage on a hit.

name: Glancing Fire
trigger: Your melee or ranged Strike misses a creature, but is not a critical miss.
effect: The target takes the listed damage, subject to the saving throw. This damage does not count as a hit and does not apply the Strike's other effects.

name: Guardian Field
effect: At the start of each ally's turn, if that ally is in the aura, it gains temporary Hit Points equal to $lowDamage. A creature can gain them from this ability only once per round.

name: Committed Blow
duration: The slowed condition lasts until the end of your next turn.
requirements: You can make a melee Strike.
effect: Make a melee Strike using the listed damage instead of its normal damage. Whether the Strike hits or misses, you are slowed 1.

name: Siege Resilience
effect: You have resistance to damage from ranged attacks equal to $minimumResistance.

name: Collective Transposition
target: Up to two willing creatures you can see, including yourself.
effect: Teleport each target to a separate unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of its starting space. Resolve both teleports simultaneously, so the targets can exchange places.

name: Shared Veil
duration: Invisibility lasts up to 1 minute, ending immediately after a target uses a hostile action.
target: Up to two willing creatures you can see.
effect: Each target becomes invisible. You can have only one Shared Veil active at a time; using it again ends the previous one.

name: Chosen Rival
effect: The first time each turn you hit the chosen creature with a melee Strike, you deal additional $lowDamage. You have resistance to damage from every other creature equal to $minimumResistance. Choosing a new rival ends this effect.

name: Shadow Prowl
duration: Invisibility lasts until the start of your next turn or until after you make a Strike, whichever comes first.
effect: Stride up to $speed. At the end of this movement, you become invisible.

name: Isolated Prey
requirements: The target is off-guard to you and has no allies adjacent to it.
target: One creature you hit with a melee Strike.
effect: On a hit, the Strike deals additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage.

name: Aegis Ward
effect: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic when you cast the spell. You and your allies within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to AC, saving throws, and attack rolls, and resistance 5 to the chosen damage type. The resistance also protects their gear. The aura moves with you; a creature gains or loses these benefits as it enters or leaves the aura. Sustain the spell once on each of your subsequent turns to keep it active; it has no maximum duration.

name: Breaching Strikes
trigger: You damage a creature with a Strike.
effect: The creature takes a –3 penalty to AC, with no saving throw. Further Strikes from you do not increase this penalty; multiple applications of Breaching Strikes do not stack.

name: Abduct
requirements: The creature has at least one creature grabbed.
effect: Stride up to $halfSpeed, pulling any grabbed creatures along with you.

name: Minion Master
requirements: Fewer than six minions created by Minion Master remain.
target: One unoccupied square adjacent to you.
effect: Create one minion in the target square. Use the attached Ranged Minion stat block. You can have no more than six minions created by Minion Master at a time. All minions created by this ability take their turns immediately after yours, including a minion created on the current turn.

name: Fiery Rebuke
trigger: A creature within 30 feet damages you.
effect: The triggering creature takes the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Delayed Magic Missile
target: One or more creatures you can see; assign each dart to one target
effect: Choose targets for $dartCount darts when you use this ability. At the start of your next turn, each dart automatically hits its assigned target and deals 1d4+1 force damage. Movement or cover gained after you choose the targets does not stop the darts. The darts resolve at the start of your next turn even if you are incapacitated or destroyed before then. Assign each dart separately. Combine the damage of darts hitting the same target before applying resistance or weakness. No attack roll or saving throw is required.

name: Leaping Knockdown
target: One creature adjacent to the landing space
effect: Leap up to $doubleSpeed, ignoring difficult terrain during the leap. This movement does not trigger reactions triggered by movement. If you end adjacent to a creature, attempt to Trip it using Athletics ($athletics) against its Reflex DC. Resolve the Trip normally; this attempt never pushes the target. This Athletics maneuver has the attack trait and counts toward multiple attack penalty normally. Use Downed Prey for its bonus damage against the prone target.

name: Breach Ram
target: One creature or barrier in a straight path
effect: Stride up to $speed in a straight line. If you end adjacent to a creature, make a melee Strike against it. On a hit, the target attempts the saving throw; failure pushes it 5 feet, and critical failure pushes it 10 feet and knocks it prone. A Strike against a barrier also deals damage to the barrier. Pair with Breaching Strikes to weaken a creature’s AC after damaging it.

name: Mirror Image
effect: Create three illusory doubles in your space. When an attack would hit you, randomly determine whether it hits you or a remaining double, with each equally likely. A double struck by an attack disappears. A failed attack that is not a critical failure removes one double and has no other effect. If a critical hit is assigned to a double, remove that double and resolve a normal hit against you instead. The spell ends when the last double disappears.

name: Push
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike with Push listed in its damage entry.
target: The creature hit by that Strike.
effect: Attempt to Shove the target using Athletics. Apply the normal Shove results, but do not apply or increase your multiple attack penalty. If the Strike specifies a Push distance, use it instead of the normal success distance.

name: Grab
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike with Grab listed in its damage entry, or you have a creature grabbed or restrained.
target: The creature hit by that Strike, or one creature held with an appendage that has Grab.
effect: After a qualifying Strike, attempt to Grapple its target using the attacking body part. Apply the normal Grapple results, but do not apply or increase your multiple attack penalty. Alternatively, choose one creature grabbed or restrained by an appendage with Grab and extend that condition automatically until the end of your next turn.

name: Knockdown
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike with Knockdown listed in its damage entry.
target: The creature hit by that Strike.
effect: Attempt to Trip the target using Athletics. Apply the normal Trip results, but do not apply or increase your multiple attack penalty.

name: Translocate
target: You and your worn and held items.
range: 120 feet; 1 mile at rank 5 or higher
effect: Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within range, bringing your worn and held items. The spell fails if another creature would travel with you, including one inside an extradimensional container. At rank 5 or higher, you may instead choose a destination you have visited and whose relative location and distance you know, even without seeing it; after this heightened casting, you are temporarily immune to Translocate for 1 hour.

name: Breathe Fire
effect: Breathe flame into the area. Each creature takes the listed damage with a basic Reflex save. Damage is 2d6 per effective spell rank.

name: Revealing Light
effect: Each creature attempts a Reflex save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: affected for 2 rounds. Failure: affected for 1 minute. Critical failure: affected for 10 minutes. An affected creature is dazzled. If invisible, it becomes concealed instead; concealment from other causes is removed.

name: Dispel Magic
target: One spell effect or unattended magic item.
effect: Attempt a counteract check against the target using your spellcasting modifier ($spellAttack) and effective spell rank. Success counteracts the spell effect or suppresses a magic item's magic for 10 minutes, leaving its mundane properties intact. Attempts against artifacts and similar items automatically fail. Use the normal counteract rules to determine which ranks your check can affect.

name: Reactive Strike
trigger: A creature within your reach uses a manipulate or move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during its move action.
effect: Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike neither takes nor increases your multiple attack penalty. A critical hit disrupts the triggering action if it has the manipulate trait.

name: Tactical Reflexes
effect: When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, gain one additional reaction usable only for Reactive Strike.

name: Heal
traits: Healing, Manipulate, Vitality; Concentrate with two or three actions
target: One willing living creature or one undead; all living and undead creatures in the area with three actions.
range: Touch with one action; 30 feet with two actions
damage_type: vitality (damage to undead; healing to willing living creatures)
effect: Use spell rank equal to half your level rounded up, minimum 1 and maximum 10. One action: touch one target, restoring the listed HP to a willing living creature or dealing the listed vitality damage to an undead creature with a basic Fortitude save. Two actions: target one creature within 30 feet; add $healBonus HP when healing a living creature. Three actions: affect all living and undead creatures in a 30-foot emanation, healing living creatures and damaging undead with the listed dice; undead attempt a basic Fortitude save. The dice are 1d8 per rank; the two-action healing bonus is 8 per rank.

name: Dazzling Flash
traits: Cleric, Concentrate, Focus, Light, Manipulate, Visual
area: 15-foot cone; 30-foot cone at rank 3 or higher
effect: Raise your religious symbol to emit a flash. Each creature attempts a Fortitude save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: dazzled for 1 round. Failure: blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute; an Interact action to rub its eyes ends the blindness. Critical failure: blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.
